environmentFinding.what: core.autocrlf=true globally, while .gitattributes pins only public/data/*.json to LF.
environmentFinding.effect: A fresh worktree checkout rewrites every audit/*.json to CRLF, so the sha256 content pins in apply-entity-cleanup.mjs (Owner Ruling 3, lane B) fail and the chain refuses to run.
environmentFinding.resolution: Worktrees were re-materialised byte-faithfully and core.autocrlf was set to false repo-locally. The canonical checkout was already LF and stayed clean throughout.
